description: This Java class implements namespace-related persistence operations for MongoDB within an event sourcing context. It manages purging data related to specific namespaces by either dropping entire collections or deleting documents based on filters.

classes.name: MongoNamespacePersistenceOperations
classes.description: Final class providing MongoDB-based namespace persistence operations such as purging data related to specific namespaces.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of MongoNamespacePersistenceOperations with provided MongoDatabase and event source settings.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Public method that initiates purging of data for a given namespace, returning a reactive source of Throwable lists.

methods.name: selectNamespace
methods.description: Private method that selects collections/selections for a given namespace.

methods.name: purgeAllSelections
methods.description: Private method that iterates over multiple selections and merges their purge results into a single source.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Private method that determines whether to drop an entire collection or delete documents based on the selection.
